title: GeoSales Intelligence Platform
summary: Enterprise-grade sales analytics platform featuring real-time GPS tracking, territory clustering, advanced behavioral analysis, and automated report generation to optimize field sales operations.
problem: Sales leadership had zero visibility into field operations — no data on territory coverage, route efficiency, or customer visit patterns. Business requirement was vague: 'better field visibility.'
solution: Translated the ambiguous business need into a concrete ML solution: GPS-based route reconstruction, territory mapping via geospatial clustering, and predictive opportunity scoring delivered through a FastAPI microservices architecture.
achievements: 35% increase in sales efficiency and 40% reduction in operational costs
< 500ms API latency with 88% prediction accuracy in production
Proactively identified and resolved data quality issues, preventing a 2-week project delay
Publication: 'A Data-Driven Spatiotemporal Framework for Retail Analytics' — ADScAI Summit 2025

pipeline.title: ML Pipeline
pipeline.content: GPS trace → Movement pattern reconstruction → Geospatial-temporal feature extraction (visit frequency, dwell time, territory overlap) → DBSCAN/OPTICS clustering for territory identification → Predictive opportunity scoring model → Real-time dashboard.

kafka.title: Real-Time Streaming
kafka.content: Apache Kafka ingests GPS streams from field devices. Custom consumer processes events with < 500ms end-to-end latency, updating territory coverage metrics and triggering alerts in real time.

impact.title: Business Impact Details
impact.content: Delivered end-to-end: scoping with stakeholders, data infrastructure, ML model development, API deployment on Azure, and React dashboard. Three major deliverables shipped within a 6-month internship.
